name: 02_shifted_anchor_layout
description: Same logical fields as the baseline, but the label sits ABOVE its value on its own line instead of inline to the left ('Label\nValue' instead of 'Label: Value'). Simulates a supplier whose form layout shifted (redesigned template, different scan crop, new stationery) — exactly the class of drift that makes a previously-learned anchor position stop matching.
represents: Layout drift within a 'known' supplier/template: the system must re-derive fields from the new positions via the 'below' direction rather than silently keeping a stale cached value from the old layout.
